code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoglycemia. There is evidence of inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), mild liver enzyme abnormalities, and a prolonged INR. These findings may suggest a systemic inflammatory or infectious process with possible coagulopathy. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
